sources.title: nafnet: Image-to-Image model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview nafnet is a lightweight image restoration model that removes blur, noise, and other artifacts from photographs using a nonlinear activation-free architecture. Built by megvii-research, this model prioritizes computational efficiency without sacrificing quality.
